info.title: RFP Amendment & Q&A Change-Impact Analyzer API
info.description: Stateless AI SF-30 Solicitation Amendment & Government Q&A Change-Impact Diff Engine, FAR 15.206 Acknowledgment Auditor, Requirement/CLIN Delta Tracker, and Invalidated Proposal Section Redrafter.

post.summary: Analyze RFP Amendment & Q&A Change Impact
post.operationId: Analyze RFP Amendment & Q&A Change Impact
post.description: Diffs base RFP/SOW text against SF-30 Solicitation Amendments, SLED Addenda, and official Government Q&A clarification matrices. Returns an executive rework risk score (0-100), mandatory FAR 15.206 SF-30 acknowledgment instructions, requirement/CLIN/deadline deltas, de-facto requirements created by Q&A answers, and invalidated proposal outline sections paired with ready-to-paste Shipley redraft language.

example.base_solicitation_text: RFP FA8732-26-R-0018 (Base Solicitation): Section L.4: Proposals are due November 10, 2026 at 14:00 EST. Volume I Technical Approach shall not exceed 25 pages. Section C.3.1: The Contractor shall deploy a FedRAMP Moderate cloud data platform supporting 5,000 concurrent users. Section C.4.2: Key Personnel Lead Cloud Architect must hold an active Top Secret clearance and AWS Solutions Architect Professional certification. Section B CLIN 0001: Base Year Cloud Migration Engineering (Firm-Fixed-Price).
example.amendment_or_qa_text: SF-30 AMENDMENT 0002 (Issued Oct 20, 2026): 1. Block 11: The proposal due date is hereby extended from November 10, 2026 to November 24, 2026 at 17:00 EST. 2. Section L.4 is revised to increase Volume I Technical Approach page limit from 25 pages to 35 pages. 3. Section C.3.1 is replaced in its entirety: The Contractor shall deploy a FedRAMP High and DoD IL5 authorized cloud data platform supporting 15,000 concurrent users with zero-trust microsegmentation. 4. Section B CLIN 0001 is converted from Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) to Time-and-Materials (T&M) with a Not-to-Exceed (NTE) ceiling of $4,200,000. GOVERNMENT Q&A LOG — Q12: Will the Government accept a Secret clearance with an active Top Secret sponsorship for the Lead Cloud Architect? Answer Q12: Yes, an active Secret clearance with Top Secret adjudication in progress is acceptable at proposal submission. Q19: Does the Government require native SIEM telemetry forwarding into the agency's Splunk Cloud instance? Answer Q19: Yes, real-time STIG-compliant log forwarding to the agency Splunk Cloud environment is mandatory under Section C.3.1.
example.current_proposal_outline: Volume I Technical (25 pages max): Sec 1.0 Executive Summary; Sec 2.0 FedRAMP Moderate Architecture (5,000 users); Sec 3.0 Key Personnel (Top Secret required at submission); Volume III Pricing: CLIN 0001 FFP Milestone Schedule.

base_solicitation_text.title: Base Solicitation Text
base_solicitation_text.description: Raw text from the base RFP, Statement of Work (Section C), Instructions (Section L), Pricing Schedule (Section B), or Evaluation Criteria (Section M).

amendment_or_qa_text.title: Amendment Or Q&A Text
amendment_or_qa_text.description: Raw text from one or more SF-30 Solicitation Amendments, SLED Addenda, or official Government Q&A clarification matrices.
